g.text: Accuracy–latency: all planned G2 variants plus their chosen G1 baseline
Clean timing after training; individual seeds; raw X = one deterministic fit; 2 warm-ups and 7 repeats
Blue Bolt codes: Q = quarter K; H = half K; P = full PCA; I = full identity (K=C); L = actual L128; R = RF31
